scripts.start: npm run build && pm2 start dist/main.js --name tango-downloader2
scripts.restart: npm run build && pm2 restart tango-downloader2
scripts.test:puppeteer: npm run build && dotenv -e .env -- ts-node --esm tests/auth.e2e.ts
scripts.test:shorttoken: npm run build && dotenv -e .env -- cross-env E2E_TEST_NAME='Stream Download' ts-node --esm tests/auth.e2e.ts
scripts.test:lifecycle: npm run build && dotenv -e .env -- ts-node --esm tests/lifecycle.e2e.ts
